description:
Criptogon
Our goal is to use NFTs and their new royalty function to give something back to society as well as to support the NFT scene. With the help of our art we want to introduce important personalities of the world history, who had or have a great influence on different areas of society and humanity. 

We will donate 10% of the proceeds of each sale and resale of our NFTs to charitable organizations. We will use another 10% of our proceeds to financially support other NFT artists.

NFTs?
Non-Fungible Tokens (NFTs) are unique cryptographic tokens that are not replaceable. Thus, the tokens are unique and cannot be replicated or destroyed.

A major advantage of NFTs are the so-called royalties. This means that when the artist mints (creates) the NFT, he can set what share (e.g. 10%) he would like to receive from the next sales. If the picture is resold by the new owner for e.g. 1000€, criptogon receives a share of 10%, i.e. 100€.

Royalties?
This concept is still under development, but it is one of the most powerful. Some NFTs will automatically pay royalties to their creators when they are sold. We will receive a 10% royalty every time the NFT is resold.

Our background
We are two friends who are already nonprofit activists and are currently working on a project in the field of education. We see NFTs and their royalty feature as a great opportunity to bring nonprofit help and support to the digital and crypto world as well.

Style
The style of the images is polygon style. The head of the person as well as the description about it are in the foreground. The description includes a short description about the person's influence as well as a quote from him. At the bottom of the image there is a QR code that leads to the NFT's website. 

Each NFT is limited and the limitation is based on the age the personality has reached.

We divide the images into different collections, such as Social Impact, Innovators, Soccer Icons, Basketball Icons, Scientists, etc.

Website
The home page of the website is divided into the different collections. Each NFT created is listed individually in the respective collection. The total amount of donations collected so far per collection shall be displayed-.

Each listed NFT should have its own subpage showing how many of the NFT have already been sold and how much has been collected in donations.
how_its_made:
We primarily used WordPress with Elementor as well the Adobe Creative Cloud. 



WordPress and Elementor was used to create our Website. The Adobe Creative Cloud (Ilustrator, Photoshop and Premiere) was used to create the artwork and the Website.



We really focused on the background story of our project because that's what difference us from "normal" NFT artists.
